title: Tom Pot
subtitle: One pot · smoky chorizo & veg pasta
description: A hearty, smoky one-pot pasta loaded with chorizo, aubergine, courgette and mushrooms in a rich harissa-spiked tomato sauce, tossed through fusilli and topped with parmesan.

source.name: Original recipe by the home cook

ingredients.note: cut to preferred size, e.g. strips cut into thirds
roughly two; cut into small pieces
crumbled in dry, not made up with water

steps.text: Heat the {{oil}} in a large pot and fry the {{onion}} and {{garlic}} until softening.
Add the {{chorizo}} and cook until it starts releasing its oil.
Stir in the {{tomato-paste}} and {{harissa}}, mixing everything through well, and cook.
Add the {{tomatoes}} along with the {{paprika}}, {{mixed-herbs}}, {{sumac}} and crumbled {{stock-cube}}. Stir and simmer.
As soon as the tomatoes go in, add the {{fusilli}} to a pan of boiling water and cook to your liking.
steps.note: Reserve a little pasta water before draining.

steps.text: If the sauce gets too thick, loosen it with a splash of the reserved pasta water to your preference.
When the {{fusilli}} is cooked, drain and add it to the sauce pot.
Mix together, serve, and top with grated {{parmesan}}.

notes: Stock cube goes in dry and crumbled, not made up with water — it seasons the sauce directly.
Roughly 100 g dried pasta per person; 500 g comfortably feeds four hungry people or five lighter portions.
Adjust the harissa up or down to taste — it's the main heat source.

nutrition.note: Rough estimate based on the recipe as written, divided across 4 servings.
